title: Fireside Chat: Unlocking the Smackover with DLE - America's Lithium Permian Opportunity
gist: Member-only listing for a 19-minute Benchmark Summit 2026 London fireside chat (Oct 22) between Standard Lithium CEO David Park and Benchmark's Adam Webb on using direct lithium extraction (DLE) to unlock the Smackover, billed as America's lithium 'Permian opportunity'. No discussion content is disclosed.

insights.claim: Standard Lithium's Benchmark Summit fireside chat billed the Smackover as 'America's Lithium Permian Opportunity', which likens US Smackover lithium brine to the Permian shale oil boom.
insights.speaker: David Park, CEO, Standard Lithium; Adam Webb, Head of Energy Raw Materials, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Expect the Smackover to be pitched as a scalable, basin-wide US lithium supply play; track Standard Lithium and other basin players.
